summary: Implemented server-side tool result logging. In llm/logs.py added _LogRowBuilder._output_segment_hashes (walks messages.parent_hash from the tip back to parent_hash, oldest first) and set "_output_message_hashes"; log_row_extras now derives tool-call ids and server result ids from those output hashes, adds "server_executed" to every tool call and result, and appends output ToolResultParts (True) after input ones (False), with "server_executed" placed right after "exception". In llm/cli.py stripped "_output_message_hashes" in annotate_log_rows, extracted _display_tool_results, and split Markdown results so local ones stay in the prompt section and server ones render under ## Response after ### Tool calls. Added the changelog bullet. Required pytest run passes (93 passed).
concerns: Key ordering of the tool_results JSON entries (server_executed after exception) matches the text-compared tests.
Markdown output for server results relies on row["tool_results"] entries carrying server_executed; legacy rows may lack the key, handled via .get().
